_comment: The shared core: the files `node run.mjs export-core` copies into a companion repo (typically a mobile app) — see docs/mobile.md. Every entry must pass scripts/core/purity.test.ts: no react/next/db/node imports, no process.env, and the whole import closure listed here. Adding a file is a deliberate act; renaming or deleting one is a breaking change for every exported copy.
